notes: Two `added` units: the anticipatory *It* of the extraposed infinitival subject (rule 25's expletive sentence, as `תוֹעֲבַת כְּסִילִים סוּר מֵרָע` → *it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil*), and the italic *so*, the waw already holding the *And* written for it (rule 51).
Both cola put the copula on the prepositional predicate under rule 49; in the second colon חָכְמָה is the clause's own subject, so the לְ phrase is what predicates of it.
